title: Matched-control count ablation

decisions.scope: standard plan: three K=20 runs (ImageNet crop-free primary, ImageNet exact, synthetic shortcut)
decisions.imagenet_subset_size: 2 samples per class (2,000 samples); decided by the author on 2026-09-24 before any A2 run

a2_imagenet_mnv2_050_exact_k20.role: secondary; also the B1-4 (P_exact with effective-area-matched controls) input

config_rule: ImageNet configs copy experiments/real_dataset_case_study/configs/imagenet_mnv2_050_{crop_free,exact}.yaml and change only source.annotation_file, controls[0].n_samples (3 -> 20), and the relative data paths (one directory deeper). The synthetic config is generated by make_inputs.py from run_threshold_validation_full._build_config with controls[0].n_samples 2 -> 20. Everything else (global_seed, operators, seeds, runtime, preprocessing) equals the baseline.
execution: python experiments/revision_1/common/run_matrix.py --matrix experiments/revision_1/a2_control_count/matrix.json --output-root experiments/revision_1/results/a2 --skip-report (run -> metrics -> analyze; one run at a time; minimum_accuracy as in the baseline case-study matrix)

subset.rule: within every class, the 2 files with the lowest sha256('rev1-a2:' + filename) (experiments/revision_1/common/subsets.py class_balanced_subset, salt 'rev1-a2')
subset.note: A subset of the 10,000 baseline samples, so K=20 results pair with the K=3 baseline sample by sample.

nested_parity.identity_gate: On the shared samples, the K=20 run's target, clean, and control items with control_index < K_baseline must have the same item_id sets as the baseline run, with identical region_params_json, effective_area_px, and seed_used, and the baseline's control items must be exactly the K=20 items with control_index < K_baseline.
nested_parity.logits: Bitwise equality is reported, not gated (deviations.md D-001: cuDNN TF32 algorithm selection depends on the batch composition). max |logit diff| histogram and top-1 changes are recorded.
nested_parity.consequence: The ablation compares K subsets within each K=20 run only; the K=3 baseline is not mixed in.

control_tensor.definition: C[a, c, k]: seed-mean of the control anchor with control_index k matched to target anchor a under condition c (control_index and target region read from the parsed region_params_json, not by splitting region_instance_id). T[a, c]: seed-mean of target anchor a under condition c. Same seed-averaging policy as ssat.analysis.control.

ablation.k1: K=1 has no z (std undefined); included only in the control-mean convergence table.
ablation.reference: K=20 of the same run (a relatively stable reference, not ground truth)

subset_schemes.prefix: control_index {0, ..., K-1}; what a run with n_samples=K would produce.
subset_schemes.global_random: replicate r = 0..R-1 draws K distinct indices from {0..19} with numpy.random.default_rng(20260923 + r).choice(20, K, replace=False), applied to every anchor and condition (equivalent to rerunning with another global seed). R = 200; K=20 has a single replicate.

ablation.z: z_c = (T[a,c] - mean_k C[a,c,S]) / std_k(C[a,c,S], ddof=d); condition evaluable iff K >= 2 and std != 0; exceeds_control = max over evaluable conditions of z_c > 2.0 (TRUE), else FALSE, UNAVAILABLE if no condition is evaluable.
ablation.other_flags: sign_consistent, multi_strategy, and ci_excludes_zero do not depend on the controls; they are taken from the K=20 run's own analysis (2,000-sample population) through the A1 feature table.
ablation.grade: experiments/revision_1/common/grade_engine.py grade_anchors with default GradeParams (tau_z 2.0, alpha 0, m 2, CI 95, beta 0) and the recomputed control statistics.
ablation.official_path_parity: Prefix K=20 grades must equal the run's analysis/reliability.parquet exactly. Prefix K=3 grades must equal the official path run inside the script on the item values filtered to control_index < 3 (ComparisonIndexer -> compare_to_controls -> compute_reliability). For synthetic, prefix K=2 is also compared this way.

outputs.control_mean_convergence.csv: |mu_K - mu_20| / sigma_20 (sigma_20 with ddof=1) over (anchor, condition) with sigma_20 > 0: median and p90 per K and scheme; for global_random, the value pooled over replicates and the 5-95 % band of the per-replicate median. K = 1, 2, 3, 5, 10.
outputs.effect_convergence.csv: |z_K - z_20| and |excess_K - excess_20| (median, p90), and the Spearman correlation of anchor max z between K and K=20, per K, scheme, and ddof.
outputs.ranking_vs_k.csv: Spearman of the dataset-level 16-cell mean excess profile (excess averaged over conditions and samples) against K=20, and per-sample top-1 cell agreement by mean excess; the target margin_drop ranking does not depend on K and is stated as such.
outputs.grade_vs_k.csv: Against K=20: agreement, kappa_linear, delta_ge2, up/down, and HIGH/LOW/UNRELIABLE shares per K, scheme, and ddof (global_random: replicate mean and 5-95 % band).
outputs.transitions_vs_k.csv: K -> K=20 grade transition matrices (prefix; global_random averaged over replicates).
outputs.replicate_variability.csv: Per anchor at fixed K (global_random): pairwise disagreement probability 1 - sum_g p_g^2 over the R replicates' grades (primary 'flip probability') and 1 - max_g p_g; distribution summary (mean, share > 0, p50, p90), and the standard deviation of the HIGH share across replicates.
outputs.marginal_gain.csv: Increase in mean agreement with K=20 per added control, and per added item; items per run = N_samples x regions x conditions-with-seeds x (1 + K) plus clean; time from the A2 run step's measured items/s (run_matrix_log.jsonl) until the A4 fits exist.
outputs.ddof_effect.csv: Per K: z distribution quantiles and HIGH share under ddof 0 and 1.
outputs.synthetic_gt_vs_k.csv: synthetic only: HIGH share of the shortcut patch anchors (cell r0/c0, as in A1) and of the other 15 cells per K, scheme, and ddof.
outputs.report: A2_REPORT.md: recommended K and limitation wording, following experiment plan section 6.6.

populations.note: CI flags depend on the 2,000-sample population; A2 numbers are not compared with the 10,000-sample K=3 baseline except in nested_parity.json.

per_region_type: grade_vs_k.csv and replicate_variability.csv are also broken down by cell type (corner / edge / center) for the ImageNet runs.
